create_SpinQuantModifier: create a SpinQuantModifier with R1/R2/R4 rotations and hadamard transform for reducing quantization loss
create_QuantizationModifier: create a QuantizationModifier targeting Linear layers with W4A16 quantization scheme ignoring lm_head
